title: Kamishiro Rui — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Let's do this just like we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it seems like everyone is already here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! Hey Rui!
Let's give it our best again today♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I can't wait for the birthday party after practice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I'm also looking forward to AFTER practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: C-C'mon Rui. Don't just stand there, let's get ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What's this? It appears that you've brought quite the flock with you, Mr. Inspector.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Yes. Today is the day I will finally capture you, Phantom Thief Ladron!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Ladron? Just another word for robber, hm? I beg that you stop with these painful nicknames.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Silence! I'll have you know it's rather befitting for lowly scum such as yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “All of you! Cease him with all of your might!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Hehe. Careful now. The area around you is bit dark. Allow me to shed some light for you...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Ack! What is this light?! It's blinding me!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everything is going well so far. Now it's time to initiate our plan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We have you cornered, Phantom Thief Ladron.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “To think that my clients were actually working for you all this time... I suppose you got me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Interesting. You've gone awfully quiet for once. Where has your usual vigor gone?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I could say the same for you, Mr. Inspector. You're not one to think twice before charging in head first.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “You learned the truth, didn't you? That I've only been stealing to help those orphans.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “And those gadgets you caught me with...were used to save the children from the clutches of criminals...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Sir... If we arrest him, those kids will...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “She has a point. Those criminals might try to go after the kids again...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Those without power in this city have suffered for years. But things only began to change when people with a sense of justice like you arrived...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Arrest me and you'll be crowned a hero overnight. With that reputation... I hope that you can change this city—”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I don't take orders from the likes of a thief!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I became an officer to save and protect the weak! Who am I to rip away the only beacon of hope they have?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is what I thought, but now I'm determined to put you in handcuffs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Huh? The inspector was supposed to let the thief go and propose joining forces to defeat the evil that lurks in the city together...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We cannot afford to let you escape today! All because...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we do, we won't be able to celebrate your birthday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you please do the honors, plushies?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. Don't forget that we're here too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Operation plushie snuggle storm was a success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay everyone, on the count of three♪ One, two...three☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I'm also looking forward to AFTER practice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see now. They were trying to throw me off by emphasizing “after.”)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You all got me. I never would've expected a surprise in the middle of rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Out of the way, coming through! Here it is☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rui! We prepared you a birthday cake♪ Now go ahead and blow the candles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looking forward to another year with you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I heard that you did an experiment that created a big rainbow in the schoolyard! Just thinking about the possibility of you using it on the Wonder Stage makes me excited!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to it. I am certain that it will make your shows even more wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How carefree... Well the rainbow was pretty and there were loads of people taking photos of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of, just as I thought we'd pulled off a great surprise for you, you went and one-upped us like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who would've thought? By the way Kamishiro, as a hall monitor, I need to ask you to please keep those to a minimum, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ The birthday surprise was a success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was. It's not every day you get to see a surprised look like that on Rui's face.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes. A testament to my flawless acting skills, honed through years of hardship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it is thanks to you and the others that I've been able to keep improving. I'm looking forward to another year with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: From blazing fires to flashing lightning, let's keep doing lots of fun effects, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll keep pushing myself in any way I can. I'm looking forward to other interesting effects you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From school to rehearsal, today's just been one surprise after another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder... Is this something that everyone experiences? I've rarely been on the receiving end of a surprise, so I wasn't really sure how to react.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I believe it is now my turn to render everyone speechless.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll continue to do my best to keep putting on outstanding shows, so I hope you look forward to them.
